question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Improvement.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given passage the correct option to be filled in the blank is **Improvement.**
 
• **Improvement: **Alterations that improve the character or state of someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** *We have seen some improvement in the condition of the slums.*
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore the correct option is Improvement.

​The complete sentence is: **The improvement of roads in the 1700s and 1800s made the transportation of goods and people much easier.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Stagnation** refers to a circumstance where something remains unchanged and does not change and develop.
 
• **Recovery** refers to the process of healing from a disease or injury.
 
• **Setback** refers to something that takes place that hinders or delays the development of a process.
